proposed_fixes.root_cause: The elevated Burn setup process may perform a legitimate VSS-related operation that CrowdStrike reports as deletion, but actual snapshot removal is not established.
plan: Obtain the detection name, flagged operation, and outcome from a sanitized CrowdStrike event.
Trace the operation to setup/update code and distinguish installer-owned temporary cleanup from any VSS delete request.
Constrain any confirmed destructive operation to installer-owned resources; if heuristic-only, pursue a narrowly scoped false-positive resolution.
Verify upgrades do not remove user restore points or snapshots.
verification: Reproduce the identified update path and verify no VSS delete request or snapshot removal occurs.
Check the resulting installer against the reported detection condition.

comment.body: Thanks for including the installer path, hashes, CrowdStrike version, and PowerToys report ZIP. The older related report #15932 described a similar installer/VSS alert, but it does not show what CrowdStrike detected in this update. Could you ask IT to share a sanitized detection event with the rule name, flagged process/operation, and whether it recorded an attempted or completed VSS deletion? Please redact organization, device, user, and tenant identifiers. This will distinguish a heuristic alert from an actual snapshot-removal path and determine whether Setup needs a code change.
